I fixed all three failing errors with one change: `packages/ai-tools/src/providers/types.mts` now uses the v4 model types. The package typecheck (`npx --no-install tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` in `packages/ai-tools`) now passes. I didn't re-run the lerna `build`, but it runs the same `tsc` and failed on these same errors.

**What was wrong:** the repo's own `AzureOpenAIProvider` interface extends the one from `@ai-sdk/azure`. It still promised v3 models (`LanguageModelV3`, `EmbeddingModelV3`, `ImageModelV3`), but the upgraded `@ai-sdk/azure` returns v4 models. That one mismatch caused all three errors:
- `types.mts:5`: the interface no longer fit the one it extends.
- `rawProviders.mts:229`: the `as AzureOpenAIProvider` cast was rejected.
- `customProviders.mts:44`: the provider was no longer accepted as `fallbackProvider`.

**The fix:** I switched the import and the 11 method return types to `LanguageModelV4`, `EmbeddingModelV4` and `ImageModelV4` from `@ai-sdk/provider`. The package already depends on `@ai-sdk/provider` `^4.0.0`, so no dependency changed. This is a type-only edit, so runtime behavior is unchanged, and I added no casts or error suppressions. The codemod had made no edits, so there was nothing to revert.

**Still failing at the repo root:** `tsc` on the root `tsconfig.json` reports 4 errors, all in `ciScripts/azure-catalog.mts`. Three are because `@azure/arm-cognitiveservices` now names a field `cost` where the script reads `costs`. The fourth is a possibly-`undefined` value passed to `Object.keys` at line 222. None of these involve the AI SDK and none were on your list, so I left them alone.
